Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
thela...@hotmail.com (The Lasombra) wrote in message news:<132cdedd.02082...@posting.google.com>...

> A Camarilla Edition Checklist in comma delimited format
> for importing into a spreadsheet or database.

Excellent work here!

However, the Rares still only add up to 99 (71 Rs, 14 R2s)! I just
checked and your list exactly matches what WW has online, but
shouldn't there be 100 Rares like there are Uncommons and Commons?

Should The Slashers and Slashers (The), like in Scrye's checklist
which is not identical to list on WW's site, actually be combined into
an R2? This could explain the discrepancy.

Has anyone opened enough boxes of Cam Ed to figure out if they get a
card more often than they should based on their rarity designation?

Jeff
